scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — older DLC and raid/boss-exclusive records

records.name: Blades of Judgement
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 112 - Advent of the Mighty God Zamasu! (skill drop)
records.effect: Fires a barrage of Ki blades through a rear halo; holding the input fires additional blades.

records.name: Holy Wrath
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 111 - The Zero Mortal Plan (Ultimate Finish/second Rosé Goku Black encounter)
records.effect: Creates a chargeable Ki sphere that can be steered while charging; charge increases its damage.

records.name: Lightning of Absolution
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 111 - The Zero Mortal Plan (first Rosé Goku Black encounter)
records.effect: Fires tracking lightning that strikes the opponent twice.

records.name: Light of Justice
records.effect: Charges briefly and fires a large mouth blast; the preset has Super Armor during the animation.

records.name: Seasoning Arrow
records.unlock_method: Demon God Demigra Skillset / Crystal Raid access
records.effect: Creates purple Ki beams that rain around Demigra and paralyze struck opponents.

records.name: Time Shackles
records.effect: Traps the opponent in a Ki sphere, dealing repeated hits before ejecting them.

records.name: Marbling Drop
records.unlock_method: Random drop from Expert Mission 20 / Crystal Raid-related access
records.effect: Creates an explosive wave and a spherical energy field that launches multiple bouncing energy spheres.

reconciliation_note: These records were absent from the repository's local docs/data/skills.json. CaC status follows the current unavailable-for-CaC classification for the raid/boss-exclusive implementations; Blades of Judgement, Holy Wrath, and Lightning of Absolution are player-obtainable PQ rewards. UF flags are only asserted where the reviewed evidence explicitly identifies the reward as an Ultimate Finish or a normal skill drop.
